segments.ja435:1.3: Ye ca gāme titikkhanti, te uḷāratarā tayā.
segments.ja435:2.3: Purisaṃ tāta seveyyaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja435:3.1: Yo te [yo taṃ (syā. jā.1.4.190 araññajātakepi)] vissāsaye tāta, vissāsañca khameyya te;
segments.ja435:3.3: Sussūsī ca titikkhī ca, taṃ bhajehi ito gato.
segments.ja435:4.1: Yassa kāyena vācāya, manasā natthi dukkaṭaṃ;
segments.ja435:4.3: Urasīva patiṭṭhāya, taṃ bhajehi ito gato.
segments.ja435:5.1: Yo ca dhammena carati, carantopi na maññati;
segments.ja435:5.3: Visuddhakāriṃ sappaññaṃ, taṃ bhajehi ito gato.
segments.ja435:6.3: Tādisaṃ tāta mā sevi, nimmanussampi ce siyā.
segments.ja435:9.1: Taṃ tāhaṃ tāta yācāmi, karassu vacanaṃ mama;
segments.ja435:9.3: Māssu bālena saṃgacchi [saṃgañchi (sī. pī.)], dukkho bālehi saṅgamoti.
